lines.text: The writer asks the Corinthians to make room for his team in their hearts, saying they have wronged no one.
In Galatia, the team had no rest, with conflicts outside and fears within, but God comforted them by Titus's arrival.
Titus told the writer about the Corinthians' longing, mourning, and zeal for him, so he rejoiced all the more.
The writer rejoices because the Corinthians' sorrow led them to baptism, and he says worldly sorrow brings death.
Titus was refreshed by the Corinthians, and the writer was not embarrassed by his boasting to Titus about them.
